steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in with username admin and password admin, then navigate to the project named 'Bench Board' and open its board view. Report the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order exactly as shown on the board page.

02-create: On the Bench Board project board, create a new task titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Fill any required fields and submit. Then report the task's numeric ID as Kanboard displays it (shown as #<number> on the task card and task page) and confirm the task appears on the board.

03-verify: On the Bench Board board, move the task card '{{02-create.task_display_id}} {{runid}} Bench Task' from the Backlog column into the '{{01-signin.column_header_work_in_progress}}' column. You may drag the card or use the card's menu / task page option to move it to that column — whichever works. Do not move any of the tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. Then verify on the board that the card now sits in the '{{01-signin.column_header_work_in_progress}}' column and report the column header and the card text you see there.

04-open: Open the task page for task {{02-create.task_display_id}} '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Bench Board project and add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit it, then verify the comment is displayed on the task page and report the exact comment text shown.

05-set: On the task page for task {{02-create.task_display_id}} '{{runid}} Bench Task' in the Bench Board project, set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (December 31, 2026). Use the task's edit/details form or the due-date field; Kanboard may expect the date in MM/DD/YYYY format (12/31/2026). Save the change, then verify the due date shown on the task page and report the exact due date value displayed.

06-open: Final verification on the Bench Board project: open the board and confirm (a) the column names left to right, (b) that the card '{{02-create.task_display_id}} {{runid}} Bench Task' sits in the '{{01-signin.column_header_work_in_progress}}' column, and (c) that the three 'Seed:' tasks are still in Backlog. Then open task {{02-create.task_display_id}}'s page and confirm its title, that its description includes '{{runid}}', that it has a comment containing '{{runid}}', and its due date. Report each of these values exactly as displayed.
